en-US.longDescription: Kigo is an open-source implementation of the popular Go game. Go is a strategic board game for two players. It is also known as igo (Japanese), weiqi or wei ch'i (Chinese) or baduk (Korean). Go is noted for being rich in strategic complexity despite its simple rules. The game is played by two players who alternately place black and white stones (playing pieces, now usually made of glass or plastic) on the vacant intersections of a grid of 19x19 lines (9x9 or 13x13 for easier games).
en-US.name: kigo

zh-CN.longDescription: Kigo 是一个开源围棋游戏实现。围棋是两个玩家进行的战略棋盘游戏。尽管围棋规则简单，却以丰富的策略复杂性而闻名。两位玩家在 19x19 方格棋盘 (简单游戏有 9x9 和 13x13 的棋盘) 上交替放置白色和黑色的棋子。
